name: Volcano
description: For most of their altitude, volcanoes are much like mountains in terms of the wildlife that they support. Close to the craters of active ones though, or near magma pools inside of them, only Pokémon that can withstand the blistering heat can survive. Naturally, this means Fire-types thrive in these areas, though sturdier Rock-types and the occasional Poison-type can be found here as well.
